# B2 vocabulary batch 98

Added 25 manually authored B2 entries: `glamourous`, `handicap`, `heart-warming`, `heartbreaking`,
`high-tech`, `hospitalise`, `humanise`, `idiot`, `idolise`, `industrialise`, `instil`, `invoke`,
`italicise`, `jeweller`, `known`, `limb`, `linen`, `liner`, `linger`, `literal`, `litter`,
`loneliness`, `long-distance`, `long-term`, and `lucrative`.

Each row was manually checked for sense, part of speech, IPA, difficulty, controlled topics, and
natural English/Vietnamese example pairs. The `idiot` entry is explicitly labelled as rude usage in
its example so it is not taught as neutral language.
